possible."},{"statement":"Unallocated dice that cannot be played become spent at the end of the player's turn.","sourceSentence":"Unallocated dice that cannot be played are considered spent at the end available shield slots"},{"statement":"Shield strength gained equals the total face value of all dice placed on shield slots.","sourceSentence":"gaining shield strength equal to the total face value part.","numericValue":{"magnitude":1,"unit":"damage","approximate":false}},{"statement":"A machine part's roll conditions are printed on the middle right side of its occasion.","sourceSentence":"A machine part can be damaged more than once per turn, but you must have enough dice to completely fulfill the damage condition each time."},{"statement":"The player
